_header: The review classes (lane autopilot-reviews, O-REVIEWS-DEPEND-ON-THE-LAPTOP). Owner rule 2026-09-29: an auth, money, user-data or API pull request gets an INDEPENDENT review before it may merge. .github/workflows/review-gate.yml runs tooling/autopilot/review-paths.mjs over a PR's file list and adds `needs-review` when any path matches a glob below; tooling/ci/land-next.mjs then waits for an owner's `VERDICT: APPROVE` on the head. Name globs are scoped to the product roots (apps, packages, services, sites, extensions) so a tooling test named after a class is not a review. Globs: `**` any depth, `*` within one segment, `{a,b}` alternatives; matched case-insensitively against the repo-relative path. Seeded from the brief, refined from this tree (packages/, services/*/src/routes, services/*/migrations, contracts/). A test fixture per class is in tooling/ci/test/autopilot-review-gate.test.mjs.
